caption: The drawing shows a single object that resembles the frame of an old-fashioned flat iron, depicted in black ink on a beige, slightly textured background. The flat iron frame is shown in three-quarters perspective, with the pointed tip facing the upper right. The frame is hollow with three parallel bars and one ornate, central bar forming the interior structure. The outer edge is reinforced with rivets. Attached to the wide end of the frame is a wooden handle, cylindrical with visible wood grain, attached perpendicularly to the metal and secured with a central bolt. The handle shows detail in shading and texturing to suggest its carved form. The drawing consists of fine dot and line techniques, with all elements rendered in monochrome, and there is a small artist’s signature in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
